name: Adults
overview: Scripture calls adults to honor and respect their parents, promising long life and blessing for such obedience, as seen in Exodus 20:12 and Proverbs 23:22. It also assures believers that God has good plans for their lives, offering hope and purpose (Jeremiah 29:11). The gospel of salvation through faith in Christ (John 3:16), the assurance that all things work together for good for those who love God (Romans 8:28), and the call to submit to God while resisting the devil (James 4:7) provide a foundation for spiritual maturity and steadfastness in the adult years.
